SEM-EFFECT-LOOKUP-001.engine_view: checked CPS frame-sequence view only; no storage or scheduling representation
SEM-EFFECT-LOOKUP-001.terminal_projection: not terminal; selected frame determines the next declared effect transition

SEM-EFFECT-RAISE-001.engine_view: checked CPS raise fact and its selected authorized frame view only
SEM-EFFECT-RAISE-001.terminal_projection: projects through the selected handler/provider or declared missing-discharge result

SEM-EFFECT-HANDLE-001.target_operational: SPEC-099b §5 handler entry and done-clause completion
SEM-EFFECT-HANDLE-001.engine_view: checked handler facts from TASK-2013 carried to separately authorized admission
SEM-EFFECT-HANDLE-001.terminal_projection: handler normal completion enters its done clause exactly once; failures use declared terminal results

SEM-EFFECT-DISCHARGE-001.engine_view: checked residual closed-row and discharge-record view only
SEM-EFFECT-DISCHARGE-001.terminal_projection: not terminal; residual closed rows constrain the following configuration

SEM-EFFECT-MISSDISCHARGE-001.cps_artifact: Raise with no matching authorized frame or residual discharge
SEM-EFFECT-MISSDISCHARGE-001.engine_view: checked CPS reports an unhandled requirement; no frame is synthesized from a row
SEM-EFFECT-MISSDISCHARGE-001.terminal_projection: structured missing-discharge outcome, with exact external classification separately owned by terminal projection

SEM-EFFECT-RESUME-001.engine_view: abstract continuation-consumed bit and reinstated original-handler view only
SEM-EFFECT-RESUME-001.terminal_projection: normal resumed completion enters the reinstated handler done clause; repeated resume is a structured trap

SEM-EFFECT-HANDLERTRAP-001.cps_artifact: Trap raised while evaluating a handler body
SEM-EFFECT-HANDLERTRAP-001.terminal_projection: structured trap; it is not converted into a provider or row discharge

SEM-EFFECT-PROVIDER-001.target_operational: SPEC-099b §5 provider boundary; PLAN-203 Admission and client parity run-control outcomes
SEM-EFFECT-PROVIDER-001.engine_view: abstract bounded external transition label and allowed-outcome set only; no host or scheduler claim
SEM-EFFECT-PROVIDER-001.terminal_projection: declared external success, failure, timeout, or cancellation outcome

SEM-EFFECT-ADMISSION-001.cps_artifact: checked CPS artifact plus separately authorized admission/frame instructions
SEM-EFFECT-ADMISSION-001.target_operational: PLAN-203 Admission and client parity checked-entry authority
SEM-EFFECT-ADMISSION-001.engine_view: admission decision view only; checked facts and rows cannot install frames
SEM-EFFECT-ADMISSION-001.terminal_projection: missing or malformed admission is a pre-entry external rejection, never evaluator fallback

SEM-EFFECT-TIMEOUT-001.target_operational: PLAN-203 Admission and client parity run-control timeout envelope
SEM-EFFECT-TIMEOUT-001.engine_view: abstract timeout outcome label only; no clock, timer, or scheduling claim

SEM-EFFECT-CANCEL-001.target_operational: PLAN-203 Admission and client parity run-control cancellation envelope
SEM-EFFECT-CANCEL-001.engine_view: abstract cancellation outcome label only; no signal or task-scheduling claim

SEM-EFFECT-TERMINAL-001.target_operational: λAsh-CPS₀ kernel Return; SPEC-099b §6 structured trap; OBS-TARGET-PROJECTION-001 external projection; PLAN-203 Admission and client parity run control
SEM-EFFECT-TERMINAL-001.engine_view: terminal classification view only; no envelope storage or client transport claim
SEM-EFFECT-TERMINAL-001.terminal_projection: the separately owned canonical terminal envelope projection
